changelog.body:
## Features

### Add

- Add an Immersive mode Quick Settings tile to hide or restore the status bar (requires Root access)
- Support adjusting the status bar clock size
- Restore the Bluetooth status bar icon
- Disable Samsung Writing Toolkit globally
- Support hiding shared albums in Gallery
- Support hiding Video Editor Studio in Gallery
- Extend AI watermark removal to Creative Studio (SketchBook)

### Optimize

- Refine 5G Quick Settings tile permission handling
- Add dedicated icons for rebooting System UI, Recovery, and Download mode
- Reorganize settings by target app
- Add Korean translation and improve multilingual strings

Star [OneUIX](https://github.com/SoClear/OneUIX)

---

## 功能

### 新增

- 新增沉浸模式快捷设置磁贴，可快速隐藏或恢复状态栏（需要 Root 权限）
- 支持调整状态栏时钟大小
- 支持恢复蓝牙状态栏图标
- 支持全局禁用三星写作工具包
- 支持隐藏相册中的共享相册
- 支持隐藏相册中的视频编辑工作室
- 禁用 AI 水印功能扩展支持 Creative Studio（SketchBook）

### 优化

- 优化 5G 快捷设置磁贴的权限处理
- 为重启系统 UI、Recovery 和下载模式添加独立图标
- 按目标应用重新整理设置页面
- 新增韩语翻译并完善多语言文本

Star [OneUIX](https://github.com/SoClear/OneUIX)

## Features

### Add

- Three rows in Recents grid

### Fix

- Fixed a lot of ClassNotFoundException

Star [OneUIX](https://github.com/SoClear/OneUIX)

---

## 功能

### 新增

• 最近任务网格显示三行

### 修复

- 修复了大量的 ClassNotFoundException

Star [OneUIX](https://github.com/SoClear/OneUIX)

> [!WARNING]
> ### ⚠️ Important Notice
> **Code refactored and migrated to LibXposed 102**
> **Please back up your configuration in advance; notification-related settings will be lost after restoration!**

## Features

### Add

- Support setting a display threshold for status bar network speeds
- Support hiding the "Close all" button in Recents

### Refactor

- Modularize project into `:app`, `:common`, and `:hook` modules
- Migrate from legacy Xposed API 82 to modern Libxposed API 102
- Reorganize settings structure, moving Notification settings under System UI

### Fix

- Only hide media ongoing activity notification while keeping Quick Settings playback controls intact

Star [OneUIX](https://github.com/SoClear/OneUIX)

---

> [!WARNING]
> ### ⚠️ 重要提醒
> **重构代码，迁移到 LibXposed 102**
> **请提前备份配置，且恢复后会丢失通知相关配置！**

## 功能

### 新增

- 支持设置状态栏网速显示阈值
- 支持隐藏最近任务中的“全部关闭”按钮

### 重构

- 项目模块化重构，拆分为 `:app`、`:common` 和 `:hook` 模块
- 从传统 Xposed API 82 迁移至现代化 Libxposed API 102
- 重新整理设置结构，将通知相关设置归类至系统 UI

### 修复

- 优化隐藏媒体实时活动逻辑，仅隐藏实时通知，保留快捷设置面板播放控件

Star [OneUIX](https://github.com/SoClear/OneUIX)

## Features

### Add

• Auto expand notifications
• Back up config and Restore config

### Fix

• Fix power consumption issue of showTraditionalChineseDateOnQS
• Fix group summary still displayed

Star OneUIX https://github.com/SoClear/OneUIX

--------

## 功能

### 新增

• 自动展开通知
• 备份和恢复配置

### 修复

• 修复快捷设置面板显示农历日期的耗电问题
• 修复通知分组摘要仍然显示的问题

Star OneUIX https://github.com/SoClear/OneUIX

## Features

### Add

- Keep screen off when unplugged

### Adapt

- Adapt for Photo Editor version 3.6.23.16

### Fix

- Keep 5G Quick Settings tile state after reboot
- Fix Lunar calendar in QS panel not updating

Star [OneUIX](https://github.com/SoClear/OneUIX)

---

## 功能

### 新增

- 拔出充电器时不亮屏

### 适配

- 适配图片编辑器版本 3.6.23.16

### 修复

- 修复重启后快捷设置 5G 磁贴状态不保留的问题
- 修复快捷设置面板农历不更新的问题

Star [OneUIX](https://github.com/SoClear/OneUIX)

## Features

### Add

- Show battery level text alongside the battery icon
- Disable notification grouping
- Hide ongoing activity for media apps
- Allow all rotation angles (enable 180° rotation on phones)
- Hide power menu "Side button settings"
- Lift FCM network limit for China/Hong Kong firmware
- Spoof phone status as Official on SmartManagerCN

### Fix

- Fix setCustomCarrierName field access error on certain One UI versions
- Keep AppsSearchBar hidden after folder click in Launcher
- Fix "Reboot to recovery" and "Reboot to download mode" failing when no background process exists

Star [OneUIX](https://github.com/SoClear/OneUIX)

---

## 功能

### 新增

- 显示电量文字
- 禁用通知分组
- 隐藏音乐应用的实时活动
- 允许所有旋转角度（手机上启用 180° 旋转）
- 隐藏关机菜单的"侧面按钮设置"
- 解除国行/港版固件对 FCM 推送的网络限制
- 在智能管理器上伪装手机状态为官方

### 修复

- 修复在某些 One UI 版本上自定义运营商名称的字段访问错误
- 修复 Launcher 中点击文件夹后搜索栏重新显示的问题
- 修复"重启到 Recovery"和"重启到下载模式"在无后台进程时失败的问题

Star [OneUIX](https://github.com/SoClear/OneUIX)

## Features

### Add

- Hide search bar on app screen
- Remove bottom-right shortcut badge from home screen shortcuts
- Add watch pairing tweaks, including WearOS CN / WearOS Global mode, pairing region check bypass, and China WearOS GMS supplement
- Customize power menu actions, including Reboot System UI, reboot to recovery, reboot to download mode, and force restart message
- Hide battery icon
- Unlock Outdoor mode
- Workaround for physical eSIM adapter
- Support dual SIM synchronous switching for the 5G Quick Settings tile
- Hide Data usage bar in Quick Settings panel
- Spoof phone status as Official
- Force Samsung Internet Custom Tabs to open in external Samsung Internet

### Adapt

- Adapt for One UI 8.5
- Hide unsupported Quick Settings options on One UI 8.5, including media player bar, nearby devices/device control bar, Smart View/modes bar, always expanded tile chunk, always show time/date, brightness level, and volume level

Star [OneUIX](https://github.com/SoClear/OneUIX)

---

## 功能

### 新增

- 隐藏应用屏幕搜索栏
- 移除桌面快捷方式图标右下角小角标
- 添加手表配对增强，包括 WearOS CN / WearOS Global 模式、配对区域检查绕过和国行 WearOS GMS 补充
- 自定义关机菜单按钮，包括重启系统 UI、重启到 Recovery、重启到下载模式和强制重启提示
- 隐藏电池图标
- 解锁户外模式
- 实体 eSIM 适配器兼容处理
- 快捷设置 5G 磁贴支持双卡同步切换
- 隐藏快捷设置面板的已用流量 Bar
- 伪装手机状态为官方
- 强制三星浏览器 Custom Tab 跳转外部三星浏览器

### 适配

- 适配 One UI 8.5
- 在 One UI 8.5 上隐藏不再适用的快捷设置配置，包括媒体播放器 Bar、附近设备和设备控制 Bar、Smart View 和模式 Bar、总是展开磁贴块、总是显示时间日期、显示亮度级别和显示音量级别

Star [OneUIX](https://github.com/SoClear/OneUIX)

## Features

### Add

- Add Russian translation
- Add camera frame watermark support
- Hide status bar on lock screen
- Switch S Pen translation source to Google
- Hide Smart View QS tile  on One UI 6.1
- Spoof Browser Region to US
- Restore playback speed visibility and improve reliability

### Fix

- Fix an issue on certain devices where OneUIX incorrectly shows as disabled despite being enabled in LSPosed
- Allow blocking more notification channels
- Adapt SmartViewLargeTileBar hook for OneUI 7

Star [OneUIX](https://github.com/SoClear/OneUIX)

---

## 功能

### 新增

- 添加俄语翻译
- 添加相机相框水印支持
- 隐藏锁屏状态栏
- 将 S Pen 翻译源切换为 Google
- 隐藏 One UI 6.1 上的 Smart View 快捷面板开关
- 伪装浏览器国家/地区代码为美国
- 恢复视频播放速度选项的可见性并提高其可靠性

### 修复

- 修复在某些设备上，尽管在 LSPosed 中已启用，但 OneUIX 仍错误显示为未激活的问题
- 允许阻止更多通知渠道
- 适配 OneUI 7 的 Smart View 快捷面板大尺寸开关

Star [OneUIX](https://github.com/SoClear/OneUIX)

## Features

### Add

- Bypass Samsung Health Monitor country check
- Support call & text on other devices
- Set battery icon width and height scale factor
- Set custom carrier name
- Reboot System UI (root)

### Remove

- Compact Chinese time and date (replace with `HH:mm EEEEEd`)

## 功能

### 新增

- 绕过 Samsung Health Monitor 国家检查
- 支持跨设备接打电话和收发短信
- 设置电池图标宽度和高度缩放倍数
- 自定义运营商名称
- 重启系统 UI (root)

### 移除

- 极简中文时间日期（用 `HH:mm EEEEEd` 代替）

Star [OneUIX](https://github.com/SoClear/OneUIX)

## Features

- Use English as the fallback language
- Support per-app language preferences
- Add French translation

## 新功能

- 英语作为后备语言
- 支持按应用设定语言偏好
- 新增法语翻译

Star [OneUIX](https://github.com/SoClear/OneUIX)

# One UI X ## 释放三星 One UI 的无限可能 | Unleash the full potential of Samsung One UI [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/SoClear/OneUIX?style=for-the-badge&logo=github)](https://github.com/SoClear/OneUIX) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/SoClear/OneUIX?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/SoClear/OneUIX/releases/latest) ![LSPosed](https://img.shields.io/badge/Powered_by-LSPosed-blue?style=flat-square&logo=android) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-AGPL%20v3-blue.svg?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/SoClear/OneUIX/blob/main/LICENSE.txt) [![Min SDK](https://img.shields.io/badge/Min_SDK-33-brightgreen?style=flat-square&logo=android)](https://developer.android.com/about/versions) [![Language](https://img.shields.io/github/languages/top/SoClear/OneUIX?style=flat-square&color=blueviolet&logo=kotlin)](https://github.com/SoClear/OneUIX) [![GitHub Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/SoClear/OneUIX/total?style=flat-square&color=blue&label=GitHub%20Downloads)](https://github.com/SoClear/OneUIX/releases) [![LSPosed Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.soclear.oneuix/total?style=flat-square&color=orange&label=LSPosed%20Downloads)](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/io.github.soclear.oneuix/releases) [简体中文](#简体中文) | [English](#english)
--- ## 简体中文 **One UI X** 是一个专为三星设备设计的强大 LSPosed 模块。它旨在提供高度可定制的系统体验，解除烦人的限制，并为状态栏、快捷设置以及系统自带应用注入强大的增强功能。 ### ✨ 功能 #### Android 系统 - 禁用每 72 小时验证锁屏密码 - 修改“保持打开”应用的最大数量 - 可以禁用系统的通知类别 - 支持应用跳转拦截 - 解除 FCM 网络限制 - 拔出充电器时不亮屏 - 全局禁用三星写作工具包 #### 系统 UI ##### 状态栏 - 修改状态栏左边距 - 修改状态栏右边距 - 设置电池图标宽度缩放倍数 - 设置电池图标高度缩放倍数 - 隐藏状态栏电池的百分号 - 隐藏电池图标 - 显示电量文字 - 支持显示实时网速 - 状态栏显示上传下载网速 - 设置状态栏日期时间格式 - 设置状态栏时间大小 - 状态栏时间每秒更新 - 隐藏安全文件夹状态栏图标 - 恢复蓝牙状态栏图标 - 实体 eSIM 适配器兼容处理 - 双击状态栏锁屏 - 修改状态栏最大通知图标数量 - 自定义运营商名称 - 隐藏锁屏界面的状态栏 ##### 快捷设置 - 快捷设置时间设为等宽字体 - 隐藏快捷设置的设备控制 - 隐藏快捷设置的 Smart View - 开启快捷设置 5G 磁贴 - 开启沉浸模式快捷设置磁贴 - 隐藏快捷设置面板的媒体播放器 Bar - 隐藏快捷设置面板的附近设备和设备控制 Bar - 隐藏快捷设置面板的安全底部提示 Bar - 隐藏快捷设置面板的已用流量 Bar - 隐藏快捷设置面板的 Smart View 和模式 Bar - 总是展开快捷设置磁贴块 - 快捷设置面板总是显示时间日期 - 快捷设置面板显示亮度级别 - 快捷设置面板显示音量级别 - 快捷设置面板显示农历 - 修改快捷设置面板时钟字体大小 - 禁用通知分组 ##### 息屏提醒 - 隐藏息屏提醒的状态栏 - 息屏提醒显示中国农历 ##### 其他 - 自定义关机菜单按钮 - 禁用截图声音 - 隐藏音乐应用的实时活动 - 允许所有旋转角度 - 自动展开通知 #### 设置 - 开发者选项显示强制最大刷新率选项 - 解锁户外模式 - 显示更多电池信息 - 应用程序信息页面显示包信息 - Wi-Fi 列表页显示当前连接速度 - 支持任意字体 - 支持自动开/关机 - 伪装手机状态为官方 #### 电话 - 支持录制通话 - 通话界面显示“录音”按钮而不是“添加通话”按钮 - 显示来电归属地 - 中国大陆样式的通话记录 - 支持跨设备接打电话和收发短信 #### 相机 - 显示相机的所有菜单（快门音、自动 HDR、Log、边框叠加水印） - 禁用相机过热检查 #### 其他 - 去除应用商店的广告 - 应用分身支持所有用户应用 - 天气源设为中国天气 - 最近任务页面显示内存信息 - 视频播放器添加 3.0 和 4.0 倍速 - 强制链接跳转外部三星浏览器 - 显示相册的所有设置 - 允许隐藏分享的相册 - 隐藏视频编辑工作室 - 支持三星笔记的所有功能 - 日历中显示中国节假日 - 支持拦截短信 - 主题和图标试用永不过期 - 伪装浏览器国家/地区代码为美国 - 禁用 AI 水印 - 绕过 Samsung Health Monitor 国家检查 - S Pen 使用谷歌翻译 - 隐藏应用屏幕搜索栏 - 移除快捷方式图标右下角小角标 - 手表连接模式（WearOS CN / WearOS Global） - 绕过手表配对区域检查 - 补充国行 WearOS GMS ### 📦 安装要求 - 运行 Samsung One UI 5.0+ 的三星设备。 - Android 13+ (API 33+) 。 - 已获取 Root 权限 (Magisk / KernelSU / APatch)。 - 已安装并激活 **LSPosed** 框架。 ### 备份 `/data/misc/[UUID]/prefs/io.github.soclear.oneuix/preference.json` 或者 `/data/misc//apexdata/[UUID]/prefs/io.github.soclear.oneuix/preference.json` ### 🤝 参与贡献 欢迎提交 Pull Request 或开 Issue 讨论新功能与 Bug 修复！ 由于 One UI 的更新可能会导致 Hook 失效，如果你发现了失效的 Hook 点，非常欢迎提交 PR 修复。 --- ## English **One UI X** is a powerful LSPosed module explicitly designed for Samsung devices. It aims to provide a highly customizable system experience, remove annoying restrictions, and inject powerful enhancements into the Status Bar, Quick Settings, and native apps. ### ✨ Features #### Android System - Disable PIN verification every 72 hours - Modify max number of 'Keep open' apps - Allow disabling system notification categories - Support app jump blocking - Lift FCM network limit - Keep screen off when unplugged - Disable Samsung Writing Toolkit globally #### System UI ##### Status Bar - Modify status bar left padding - Modify status bar right padding - Set battery icon width scale factor - Set battery icon height scale factor - Hide battery percentage sign in status bar - Hide battery icon - Show battery level text - Support displaying real-time network speed - Show separate upload/download speeds in status bar - Set status bar date and time format - Set status bar clock size - Update status bar clock every second - Hide Secure Folder status bar icon - Restore Bluetooth status bar icon - Workaround for physical eSIM adapter - Double tap status bar to sleep - Modify maximum number of notification icons in status bar - Set custom carrier name - Hide status bar on lock screen ##### Quick Settings - Set Quick Settings clock to monospaced font - Hide Device Control in Quick Settings - Hide Smart View in Quick Settings - Enable 5G Quick Settings tile - Enable Immersive mode Quick Settings tile - Hide Media Player bar in QS panel - Hide Nearby Devices and Device Control bar in QS panel - Hide Security footer bar in QS panel - Hide Data usage bar in QS panel - Hide Smart View and Modes bar in QS panel - Always expand Quick Settings tile chunk - Always show time and date in QS panel - Show brightness level in QS panel - Show volume level in QS panel - Show Lunar calendar in QS panel - Modify Quick Settings panel clock text size - Disable notification grouping ##### Always On Display - Hide AOD status bar - Show Chinese Lunar calendar on AOD/Lock screen ##### Other - Customize power menu actions - Disable screenshot sound - Hide ongoing activity for media apps - Allow all rotation angles - Auto expand notifications #### Settings - Show 'Force peak refresh rate' in Developer options - Unlock Outdoor mode - Show more battery info - Show package info on App Info page - Show current link speed in Wi-Fi list - Support any font - Support Auto power on/off - Spoof phone status as Official #### Phone - Support call recording - Show 'Record' button instead of 'Add call' button on call screen - Show caller location in recent calls - Mainland China style call log - Support call & text on other devices #### Camera - Show all camera menus (Shutter sound, Auto HDR, Log, Frame watermark) - Disable camera temperature check #### Other - Remove ads in Galaxy Store - Make all user apps available for app cloning - Set weather provider to China Weather - Show memory usage in Recents page - Add 3.0x and 4.0x playback speeds to video player - Force links to open in external Samsung Internet - Show all Gallery settings - Allow hiding shared albums - Hide Video Editor Studio - Support all Samsung Notes features - Show Chinese holidays in Calendar - Support message blocking - Never expire theme and icon trials - Spoof Browser Region to US - Disable AI watermark - Bypass Samsung Health Monitor country check - Use Google Translate for S Pen - Hide search bar on app screen - Remove bottom-right shortcut badge - Watch connection mode (WearOS CN / WearOS Global) - Bypass watch pairing region checks - Supplement China WearOS GMS ### 📦 Installation Requirements - Samsung devices running Samsung One UI 5.0+. - Android 13+ (API 33+). - Root access acquired (Magisk / KernelSU / APatch). - **LSPosed** framework installed and activated. ### Backup `/data/misc/[UUID]/prefs/io.github.soclear.oneuix/preference.json` or `/data/misc//apexdata/[UUID]/prefs/io.github.soclear.oneuix/preference.json` ### 🤝 Contributing Feel free to submit Pull Requests or open Issues to discuss new features and bug fixes! Since One UI updates may cause hooks to fail, if you find any invalid hook points, you are highly encouraged to submit a PR to fix them. --- 感谢 | Thanks - [Firefds Kit](https://github.com/Firefds/FirefdsKit) - [OneDesign](https://github.com/qlenlen/android_kernel_samsung_sm8550)
